build_abbr_extension: build a Python-Markdown abbreviation extension that replaces text with HTML abbr elements using a glossary
create_abbr_treeprocessor: create an AbbrTreeprocessor that recursively iterates over an ElementTree and wraps known abbreviations in abbr tags
test_abbr_blockprocessor: test the AbbrBlockprocessor to parse markdown blocks and extract abbreviation references into a dictionary
review_abbr_extension_load_glossary: review the AbbrExtension load_glossary method to add abbreviation definitions from a dictionary to the glossary
refactor_abbr_inlineprocessor: refactor the deprecated AbbrInlineProcessor handleMatch method to create abbr elements with title attributes
